items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1960
items.q: Well, some of those I heard was Joe Robichaud, Papa Silasin, and the Eagle Band. I played with the Eagle Band myself.

ctx.x: Mr. Deer, would you tell us some of the bands that you heard while you were out listening and tell us some of the groups that you may have played with?
Well, some of those I heard was Joe Robichaud, Papa Silasin, and the Eagle Band. I played with the Eagle Band myself.
And what are they now? Kid Ory.
